exposure: Gestational age at birth (37 weeks, 38 weeks, 39-40 weeks)
outcome: Admission to neonatal intensive care unit (NICU)
cohort: 18,652 singleton live newborns in Brazil born between 37 0/7 and 40 6/7 weeks of gestation
finding: Birth at 37 and 38 weeks' gestation was associated with increased odds of several adverse infant outcomes, particularly for provider-initiated births, compared to birth at 39-40 weeks.
